newsitem.title: USA: ConEd sees Indian Pt 2 nuke up this weekend.
newsitem.headline: ConEd sees Indian Pt 2 nuke up this weekend.

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc (ConEd) has postponed the resumption of production from its 975 megawatt (MW) Indian Point nuclear power unit 2 to this weekend, a company spokesman said.
"We expect to begin startup tomorrow and hit the (electricity) grid this weekend," spokesman Michael Spall said Thursday.
The company had originally said it planned to resume power production from the unit on March 12. The restart was postponed however, for further restart testing, Spall said.
Indian Point 2, located in Indian Point, N.Y., was shut Jan 27 to repair a feedwater valve. A restart planned for late February was delayed for valve repairs.
Separately, the New York Power Authority's adjacent 965 MW Indian Point 3 nuclear power unit was operating at full capacity as of early Thursday.
